title: I left (FAILED) copies
text: After a panel error, save, `reload_panel`, read back, finish the remaining steps, and list any failed copy in the handover for the user to delete. Never delete it myself.

source.heading: My own mistakes, and what stops each one (agent, 2026-11-25)

confirm: Did any panel error occur, and which (FAILED) copies does the handover list?
